card.name: Gap before a number or split word start
card.fires_on: The empty space right before a number of doses, cycles, months or years after 'for' or 'up to'. Also the start of a word split in two, such as 'post' in postmarketing or 'nit' in nitrites.

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: The blank token after 'for' or 'up to' that comes just before a number of doses, cycles, months or years.
modes.example: every 3 weeks for<< >>4 doses. After completing 4 doses

modes.label: First part of split word
modes.description: The first piece of a word broken in two, such as 'post' in postmarketing or 'nit' in nitrites.
modes.example: have been reported in patients with MS treated with OCREVUS in the<< post>>marketing setting.
